name: reporte-pedidos-lp
description: Dashboard de Reporte de Pedidos LP

scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n api,web "cd backend && go build -o .dev-api ./cmd/api && exec ./.dev-api" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.deploy: gcloud run deploy reporte-pedidos-lp --source . --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --project fechaestimadaentregaprod --set-env-vars="GCP_PROJECT_ID=fechaestimadaentregaprod,BQ_LOCATION=US"
